name: Cheech & Chong - 2g Disposable Vapes - Kiwi Pie
description:
Sweet, tangy, and dessert-smooth. The Cheech & Chong Kiwi Pie disposable packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Kiwi Pie brings a bright, fruit-forward profile: tangy, juicy kiwi up front layered with a sweet, creamy filling and a smooth, buttery crust finish. It's a fresh-meets-indulgent flavor made for anyone who likes their sessions bright, sweet, and full of taste.

Why you'll love it:

2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Kiwi Pie flavor — tangy kiwi with sweet cream and a buttery crust finish
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Bright flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Kiwi Pie is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
